periods.time: Ayase memories, two-year coma, and awakening after dojo return
periods.label: 最后武士的未竟奥义

status.health: terminal heart disease; comatose for two years after Kuraudo duel; awakens in epilogue

appearance.overview: Once a robust middle-aged swordsman; during coma he is emaciated and corpse-like from illness and injury.

personality.summary: A stern but loving teacher who preaches dignity, yet beneath that discipline retains a swordsman's fierce joy in true battle.
values: entrusting the school to the next generation
personality.inner_conflict: Illness forces him to stop wielding the sword even though his soul still yearns for a worthy fight.

relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Opponent who forced out his last true duel; he apologizes for failing to complete it.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Admirer and indirect student; on waking he jokingly demands Ikki marry Ayase and inherit the dojo.

periods.summary: Kaito is introduced teaching Ayase his ultimate technique despite worsening illness. Two years earlier, Kuraudo attacked his disciples to force a wager duel. Kaito accepted both to protect the dojo and because his swordsman's soul desired the fight. He lost before completing Ten'i Muhou, fell into a coma, and repeatedly murmured apologies that Ayase misread as regret toward her. After Ikki defeats Kuraudo and the dojo is returned, Kaito awakens and immediately shows enough vigor to embarrass Ayase by joking about marriage and succession.

key_events.summary: Entrusts his secret technique to Ayase before he can no longer hold a sword.
Loses to Kuraudo in a brutal duel that leaves him comatose.
Awakens after the dojo is reclaimed and jokes with Ayase and Ikki.
